name: Ashwick
fantasy: The flue sweep. Soaks foes in Char with a torch lance, flashes them over, and hits back harder after every knock.
silhouette: the tall sooty top hat and the bellows on the back

card.loop: Hold the torch lance to build Char, flash the foe over, then upgrade and spread it with Cinder Shot and Spark Leap. Knocks reset your cloak.
card.dash: Two charges of a leap through the foe: a burst and half a Flashover of Char.
card.passive: Every hit builds Char; at 31 the foe Flashes over (burns 3s). Stoking a foe that already burns upgrades the burn. A knock heals you.
card.rmb: Tap: a cinder shot. On a burning foe it upgrades the burn and spreads it to those around.
card.e: Scorch and drag nearby foes in, and shield up. A knock resets it.

weapons.flamethrower: Hold to roar out a 6m cone of fire; it builds Char fast. 8 seconds of fuel, then a short refill.

passive.name: Flashover
passive.desc: Your fire builds Char on foes (it all falls off after 5s). At 31 Char the foe Flashes over: 3s of burning for 2% of their health a second; fed again to full Char it becomes a fiercer burn (4%). Anything that stokes a foe already burning upgrades it. A knock heals you 16% of your health.

dash.name: Spark Leap
dash.desc: A 4.4m leap through the first foe: 13 damage, a nudge and 17 Char (half a Flashover). A knock restores one charge only.

variants.tap: Fire a cinder 14m: 14 damage and it Flashes the foe over. On a foe that is already burning it upgrades the burn and spreads the burn to foes within 4m.

e.name: Furnace Cloak
e.desc: A 4.5m wave of heat: 9 damage, 16 Char and Anti-Heal for 3s, and foes in sight are dragged toward you (walls stop them). Hit anyone and you wear a 3s shield of 6.4% health plus 5.1% per foe. A knock resets it.

rank3.dash: stokes the foe: upgrades their burn at once, and leaves a 3s fire trail
rank3.sec: hitting refunds 25% of the cooldown and +60% damage
rank3.kin: +50% damage and shield; stoking refunds 25% of the cooldown

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 7s -> 4.6s, damage +50%; refunds 25% of the cooldown when it stokes.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 9s -> 7.8s; stokes the foe at once and leaves a 3s fire trail.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 10.5s -> 6.5s, damage and shield +50%; refunds 25% of the cooldown when it stokes.

tells.half: embers drift off the hat from half Char on the nearest foe
tells.full: a foe at full Char glows white-hot
